title: Specified mixed compact-support exchange and its realization coordinates
statement: For finite commutative coefficients A and a Cartesian scheme square h,f′,f,g [def-cbc-compact-support-square], transport exact fixed-scalar functors by the intrinsic module realization equivalences. Transport the ordinary open-extension base-change isomorphism [lem-cbc-proetale-extension-zero-base-change] by these same equivalences and their unit-normalized tensor-pullback identifications. Pull a compactification c of f back along the square. Define its intrinsic compact-support exchange to be the proper counit-mate [def-weil-pbc-adjunction-mate], followed by the direct image of this open-extension comparison, in the order specified in [def-cbc-exchange-map]. Restrict constant-ring derived pullback to the full bounded constructible finite-Tor subcategories whenever its preservation certificate is given. These are exactly mixedDerivedTransport, mixedOpenBaseChangeIso, mixedPullbackCompactification, mixedCompactSupportExchange, and mixedCtfPullback; they introduce no new choice of comparison.

def mixedDerivedTransport (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}}
    (F : Sheaf (ProEt.topology X) (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1, u} A)) ⥤
      Sheaf (ProEt.topology Y) (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1, u} A)))
    [F.Additive] [PreservesFiniteLimits F] [PreservesFiniteColimits F] :
    ((sfIntrinsicModuleEquivalence X A).inverse ⋙ F ⋙
        (sfIntrinsicModuleEquivalence Y A).functor).mapDerivedCategory ≅
      (sfIntrinsicDerivedEquivalence X A).inverse ⋙ F.mapDerivedCategory ⋙
        (sfIntrinsicDerivedEquivalence Y A).functor
